title: Bulacan Half Marathon 2027 Review: What the 2026 Race Was Like
seo_title: Bulacan Half Marathon Review: 2026 Results, Weather, Field Size
meta_description: Bulacan Half Marathon review from the 2026 race in Plaridel: cool 22°C air before dawn, 3,367 half-marathon finishers (up 75% on 2025), a 2:36 median and what changes for 2027.
dek: What Team Malofit's February half marathon in Bulacan was like in 2026: the cool dry-season morning, a field that nearly doubled in a year, how fast it ran, and the move to a new venue for 2027.
verdict: Enter if you want a big, well-attended half marathon north of Manila in the coolest weeks of the year. The 2026 race, run from Waltermart Plaridel, drew 3,367 half-marathon finishers, 75% more than in 2025, and the air at 4am was about 22°C under a clear sky, warming to 25°C only by 8am. The field is broad and recreational: half took longer than 2:36 and only 15% broke two hours. For 2027 the race moves to SM Center Pulilan, so the course will change.

sections.heading: The Race and the Course
paragraphs: The 2026 Bulacan Half Marathon, sponsored by Isuzu and organised by Team Malofit with the Plaridel running shop Pairfect Fit, was held on Sunday 22 February from the Philstar Grounds at Waltermart Plaridel, with a 21 km, a 10 km and a 5 km [1][3]. The 2025 edition used the same venue [2].

The organiser described a course through Plaridel's main roads and hydration stations along the way, and posted route maps for each distance as images [1]. It did not publish gun times, cut-offs or the number of drinks stations. The results system records the event at 3am [3].

sections.heading: The Weather: Cool and Clear
paragraphs: Race morning in 2026 was kind. Open-Meteo's reanalysis for the grid point at Plaridel shows about 22°C at 3am and 21°C to 22°C until 7am, with a dew point near 20°C, 85% to 90% humidity, a light breeze and almost no cloud [5]. It warmed to about 25°C at 8am, 27°C at 9am and 29°C at 10am [5].
A 20°C dew point is comfortable by Philippine standards. From any pre-dawn start, a median half marathoner at 2:36 finished before 8am and before it passed 25°C; only the slowest runners met the sun.

sections.heading: How Fast the Field Is
paragraphs: The front is quick: the half marathon was won in 1:07:10 by a man and 1:20:31 by a woman [6]. Behind them the field thins out fast. Tenth place was 1:26:22 and tenth woman 1:44:46; the median finisher took 2:36:10 and the slowest tenth more than 3:24 [6]. Only 15% broke two hours and 44% broke 2:30, and 27% of finishers were women [6]. Thirty-eight finishers took longer than four hours, the slowest 4:29 [6].
The 10 km had 940 finishers, a median of 1:29:43 and 6% under an hour; 53% were women [6].

The race is growing fast. Half-marathon finishers rose from 1,929 in 2025 to 3,367 in 2026, up 75%, and the median slowed by almost four minutes, from 2:32:29 to 2:36:10 [6][7]. The 10 km grew by 62%, from 581 to 940 finishers, and its median slowed from 1:26:54 to 1:29:43 [6][7].

sections.heading: Entry and What You Get
paragraphs: In 2025 the half marathon cost PHP 1,799, the 10 km PHP 1,399 and the 5 km PHP 899 [2]. Half marathoners got a full-sublimation singlet and finisher shirt, a 5.5-inch medal, socks and a string bag; the 10 km had a finisher shirt and a 4-inch medal, and the 5 km no finisher shirt [2]. Runners could register online or in person at Pairfect Fit on the Plaridel diversion road, opposite Waltermart [2].
For 2027 the race moves to SM Center Pulilan, and the first 2,000 registered 21 km runners get performance socks [4].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2027 Race?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want a big, social half marathon in cool February air, where a two-hour runner finishes in the top sixth and a 2:45 finish is mid-pack.
Think twice if you need to know the course and the limits in advance: in 2026 neither gun times nor cut-offs were published, and the 2027 venue means a new route.
The 2027 race is on Sunday 21 February at SM Center Pulilan [4].
Nobody from this site ran the race. This review draws on event listings, the full results for 2025 and 2026, and modelled weather data.

faqs.question: How fast is the Bulacan Half Marathon field?
faqs.answer: Fast at the front, relaxed behind it. In 2026 the half marathon was won in 1:07:10 by a man and 1:20:31 by a woman, but the median finisher took 2:36:10 and only 15% of the 3,367 finishers broke two hours. Tenth place overall was 1:26:22.

faqs.question: Is the Bulacan Half Marathon getting bigger?
faqs.answer: Yes, quickly. Half-marathon finishers rose from 1,929 in 2025 to 3,367 in 2026, up 75%, and 10 km finishers from 581 to 940. The median half-marathon time slowed by almost four minutes, to 2:36:10, The 2027 race moves to SM Center Pulilan.

faqs.question: What is the weather like at the Bulacan Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: Cool for the Philippines. Modelled weather for Plaridel shows about 22°C before dawn on race day in 2026, with a 20°C dew point, light wind and a clear sky. It was still only about 25°C at 8am, reaching 27°C at 9am, so most runners finished in good conditions.

editorial_notes: Written 2026-11-06 about the previous edition (Sunday 22 February 2026, Waltermart Plaridel), with 2025 results for comparison. The 2027 race moves to SM Center Pulilan; the 2026 race was not there. Evidence beyond the results is thin: gun times, cut-offs, aid stations and route detail were not published in text (route maps are images), no news report or runner account was found, and the organiser's Facebook page could not be read. The 3am time is the event time stored by the results system, not a confirmed gun time. Finish-time figures are Run SEA's analysis of the official MyRunTime results for 2026 and 2025; one 10 km time under 26 minutes was dropped as timing junk. Weather is Open-Meteo modelled reanalysis for the grid point at Plaridel, not a station observation. The separate Bulacan Marathon (August, Pulilan) is a different event and is not used. No rating.
